notes:
- Bulk prompt queueing: paste multiple prompts (from code blocks, numbered
  lists, dividers, or paragraphs) to queue them automatically with live
  progress, pause, resume, and per-character cast expansion.
- 3-pane preset browser and bulk manager: full category browsing, multi-select
  editing that preserves untouched settings across presets, category renaming,
  "Use random match", "Queue selected", backup export/import (.spresets), and
  Markdown export.
- Character library and character lock: manage character profiles and
  multi-version LoRAs, automatically include appearance descriptions, and lock
  active characters across preset changes.
- Modern social aspect ratios: 4:5 Portrait (social) and 9:16 Vertical
  (vertical) across all resolution tiers.
- Output library: browse all completed generations with infinite scroll,
  instant search filtering, and one-click store-only ZIP archive download.
- UI and mobile refinements: mobile source-image button in Transform and
  Inpaint modes, direct Preset Library shortcut on the workspace bar,
  Ctrl/Cmd+Enter generation shortcut, and improved touch gestures.
